main.body: The USTR proposed tariffs on 14 economies: Vietnam up to 35%, India 25%, China 20%, the EU, Japan, Korea and Taiwan up to 15%. Hearings start 25 January.
main.headline: US PROPOSES TARIFFS ON 14 ECONOMIES
main.note: Announced Wednesday 25 Nov (US daytime); the opened USTR release carries no clock time. Rates per the USTR release itself: Vietnam up to 35%, India up to 25%, China up to 20% (Annex A goods up to 10%), EU/Japan/Korea/Switzerland/Taiwan up to 15%, Bangladesh/Cambodia/Indonesia/Malaysia/Thailand up to 18%, Singapore up to 20%. China fallback up to 40% if engagement proves unsatisfactory (Federal Register notice, via ruibao.news/Korea Times). Comments and hearing requests due 5 January 2027; hearings from 25 January 2027. Probe opened 11 March 2026; follows the Supreme Court's February 2026 ruling striking down IEEPA tariffs.

medium.headline: Oil tanker fire kills at least 31 near Cairo
medium.note: Fuel tanker overturned on the Ring Road at El Warraq, Giza, about 18:08 EGY (16:08 UTC) on Wednesday, bursting into flames and engulfing 27 vehicles. Health ministry: at least 31 dead, 21 injured (preliminary; toll may rise). Sources: CNN, AP, AFP via Times of Israel, Wikipedia.

medium.headline: Russian strikes cut power in five regions
medium.note: Overnight and morning strikes on 25 Nov killed at least five and cut power in Dnipropetrovsk, Donetsk, Zaporizhzhia, Odesa and Kharkiv. The Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant lost external power at 05:28 local (03:28 UTC) and switched to diesel generators - its 17th loss of external power in 2026, 28th in the conflict; IAEA confirmed. Sources: Al Jazeera, UNN, Ukrainska Pravda, IAEA.
